title: Valentine proposal single-page experience (evasive No + meme on Yes)

requirements.summary: Build a single-page Valentine proposal UI with a centered romantic card and consistent pink-and-white theme.
acceptanceCriteria: The landing view shows a centered romantic card/section with the question text: "Will you be my Valentine?"
The UI uses a coherent pink-and-white color scheme across background, typography, and buttons
The page is usable on Android Chrome (mobile viewport) without horizontal scrolling

file_operations.description: Create the app’s single-screen composition that renders the Valentine proposal experience as the only interactive screen (no additional routes/pages beyond this screen).

Implement the centered romantic card layout with the question text and Yes/No actions. Use shadcn-ui components (e.g., Card, Button) to compose the UI without modifying any files under frontend/src/components/ui; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add global styling and Tailwind layer customizations to enforce a pink-and-white theme (background, foreground, primary/accent button colors) and prevent horizontal scrolling on mobile viewports.

requirements.summary: Make the No button evade interaction by relocating to random positions within a bounded container on hover/touch.
acceptanceCriteria: On desktop: moving the cursor onto the "No" button triggers it to relocate within the visible bounds of its container
On mobile: tapping/pressing near/on the "No" button triggers it to relocate within the visible bounds of its container
The "No" button never moves off-screen or under other UI in a way that makes the page layout break
It is not possible to click/tap the "No" button under normal use because it moves away before activation

file_operations.description: Add client-side logic to measure the container and button dimensions, then reposition the No button to a new random in-bounds coordinate on pointer/mouse enter and touch/pointer interactions; ensure the container uses relative positioning and overflow handling so the layout remains stable.

Ensure global styles support the evasion container (e.g., preventing page-level horizontal scroll, ensuring the interactive area can safely contain absolute-positioned elements without breaking layout).

requirements.summary: On Yes, transition to a success state showing the static meme image and the exact text "Good choice".
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking/tapping "Yes" replaces (or clearly transitions from) the initial question view to a success view
The success view includes the text "Good choice" exactly
The success view displays the provided/generated meme image reliably as a static asset in the frontend (not fetched from the backend)

file_operations.description: Add the generated meme image asset to the frontend’s static public assets so it can be displayed reliably without any backend calls.

Add acceptance-state UI and state transition on Yes click/tap to show the text "Good choice" and render the static image from frontend/public/assets/generated/valentine-meme-good-choice.dim_1024x1024.png within the success view.

requirements.summary: Keep the experience fully client-side with no backend dependencies or backend method calls.
acceptanceCriteria: All interactions (No evasion, Yes success state) work without calling backend methods
The backend canister does not need new APIs for this feature
The frontend runs as a static interactive page within the app (React app in the browser)

file_operations.description: Ensure all interactivity is implemented with React client-side state and DOM measurement only; do not import or call any backend actor/client capabilities for this feature.
Wire the Valentine proposal component as the sole rendered screen so the app functions as a single interactive page without additional routes and without requiring any backend functionality.
